article_content: Şandeya Yekîtîya Niştîmanî Kurdistan (YNK) di Çarşemê de di Koşka Çankaya de bi Serokomarê Tirkîyê Abdullah Gul re civîya, lê hemû kes dizanin ev civîn di bin fîşareke giran a siyasî ji aliyên tirk û kurdan re hat çêbûn. Çavkanî jî nîşan didin ku em digel mizgîneke mûcdar, ev civişk di bin sedema şermezar û takera siyasi derbas bû. Nûnerê YNK’ê li Enqerê Bahroz Galalî, li derbarê civîna bi Serokomar Abdullah Gul re dibêje ku pêwendiyên tirkî-kurdî hîn jî jêhatinê nîşan natide, herçiqas mamoste Mam Celal bi şanazî hatin xêz kirin. Galalî hem di gotinê de dema ku Serokomarê Tirk hatibû gotin: ‘Em her tiştê di nav ilin îro bi dest ixçirin in, lê erd ji me neyê parastin’. Li ser naveroka hevdîtinê, Birêz Galalî diyar dike ku danûstandinên tirk û kurdan niha li ser zozanek tije û şaxa siyasiyê rawestandine û rewşa Rojhilata Navîn şikestî bûye. Herdu alî bal li ser dîyalogê dan, lê ew dîyalog bi rastî tenê di rewşeke ne muwekker de pêk tê û pirsa kurdan li Tirkîyê bi hêvî hinek nêrîn nedît. Piştî civîna do Çarşemê, Serokomarê Tirkîyê êvarê jî li Koşka Çankaya şanazî ji şandeya YNK’ê kir, lê ew jî got ku girîngtirîn mijaran bêyî encamên rastîn maye. Şandeya YNK’ê bi Seroktîya Xosret Resûl Elî îro Pêncşemê jî li avahîya Serokwezîrtîya Tirkîyê bi Serokwezîr Recep Tayyîp Erdogan re civînek anî, lê dîalogeke rastî tu qet qewimastinî nedît.
translated_content: The Patriotic Union of Kurdistan (YNK) delegation met with Turkish President Abdullah Gul at Çankaya Palace on Wednesday, but it’s clear to everyone that this meeting happened under heavy political pressure from both Turkish and Kurdish sides. The supposedly positive news masked a meeting filled with scandal and hardship. YNK’s representative in Ankara, Bahroz Galali, stated that Turkish-Kurdish relations still show no sign of real progress, no matter the official honors given to Mam Jalal. Galali also said the Turkish President allegedly remarked: ‘We can do anything within these borders today, but the land does not belong to us.’ Galali stressed that current talks between the Turkish and Kurdish sides are now deadlocked, and the Middle East situation has turned disastrous. Both sides claimed to favor dialogue, but in reality, the dialogue only happens in a climate of distrust, and there remains little real hope for resolving the Kurdish issue in Turkey. After Wednesday’s meeting, the Turkish President again hosted the YNK delegation at Çankaya Palace in the evening, but admitted the most important issues remain unresolved. Led by Kosrat Rasul Ali, the YNK delegation also met today with Turkish Prime Minister Recep Tayyip Erdogan, but there was no real opportunity for genuine dialogue.

article_content: Di Civata Neteweyên Yekgirtî de, Amerîka daxwaza Çîn ku hemû welatên endam beşên xwe yên darayî dabîn bikin red kir, û vê daxwazê wiha anlaye de qebûlkirin ku rêveberiya xetaya Çînê di dema koronayê de hebû. Di civînê de, Çîn bi fermî ragihand ku Amerîka qerzdarê herî giring e û divê 1,332 milyar dolar bo projesaziyên aştiyê bidê. Amerîka daxwaza Çîn birêvebiriyê xetaya liser koronayê nedixwaze zivirîne û ragihand ku xwe 726 milyon dolar bo projesaziyên aştiyê da û dixwaze para xwe ya piçûk jî heta dawiya salê dabîn bike. Amerîka beşdarbûna abûrî ya herî giring a Neteweyên Yekgirtî tê hesibandin û xelata 25% ji bûdceya salane ya projesaziyê aştiyê dibîne, ku hemû gotûbêjkirina 6 milyar dolar dibe. Di belgeyên fermî de tê xuyakirin ku Amerîka divê 27.89% bidê, lê biryara kongrêsê re 25% dixwaze û ev sebeb dibe ku qerzdar bimîne. Amerîka qebûl kird ku 888 milyon dolar qerzi heye u diyar kir ku ev encamê ye ji ber ku tenê 25% ji sala 2017-ê heta niha tê dide.
translated_content: At the United Nations, the United States rejected China’s request that all member states fully pay their financial contributions, regarding it as China’s effort to distract from its own ‘mismanagement’ during the COVID-19 pandemic. During the same session, China officially stated that the United States is the largest debtor and should pay $1.332 billion for peacekeeping operations. The US responded that China was shifting blame for its handling of the COVID-19 crisis, adding that the US had already contributed $726 million to peacekeeping and planned to pay the remaining amount by year-end. The US is the biggest financial supporter of the UN, contributing 25% of the annual $6 billion peacekeeping budget. According to official records, the US is expected to contribute 27.89%, but due to a Congressional ruling only pays 25%, which creates its current debt. The US acknowledged a debt of $888 million, explaining this shortfall results from its payment rate of 25% since 2017.
post_content: Tengiya nû li #Neteweyên_Yekgirtî! Amerîka daxwaza darayî ya Çîn red kir û got xebata xerab a koronayê tê veşartin. Amerîka qebûl kir 888 milion dolar qerz dike, çimkî tenê 25% didet. #UN #Siyaset
translated_post: Tensions flared at the #UN as the US pushed back on China’s demand for full payments, calling it an attempt to dodge blame over COVID-19. The US admits it owes $888M in peacekeeping dues, paying less due to Congress. #Politics #UNNews

translated_content: The report from Iraq’s Assessment Team is 160 pages long and includes 79 recommendations. Recommendation number 30, found on page 65, addresses the situation in Kirkuk, stating: 'Kirkuk is facing an extremely dangerous situation, and international intervention is needed to prevent major violence.' The city’s residents—Kurds, Arabs, and Turkmens—are described as metaphorically ‘sitting on a ticking time bomb.’ According to the Iraqi constitution, a general referendum was supposed to occur before the end of 2007, but this has not yet happened, and the report suggests this process be postponed. Resolving the Kirkuk issue should be the cornerstone of the International Support Group’s efforts in Iraq and integrated into new diplomatic initiatives. Brosk Toghan has provided a summary of some key recommendations, which you can listen to in an 8-minute audio file.
